items.text: Zombie Apocalypse🔥 @toapisai Dusk settles over a ruined megacity as an elite squad smashes through abandoned barricades straight into the epicenter of a feral horde. 30 seconds of relentless tactical warfare ✨Seedance 2.5 is LIVE on ToAPIs API Video Prompt: Create a 30-second photorealistic live-action blockbuster zombie action trailer video in 16:9 horizontal format. STRICT TEMPORAL & SEQUENCE ANCHOR DIRECTIVE (CRITICAL ENGINE EXECUTION): The video generator MUST execute narrative actions in EXACT CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER step-by-step across the continuous 30-second timeline. Do NOT skip, blend, or reorder any steps. Follow the timeline anchors sequentially: Step 1 (0–6s): Armored truck smashes barricade, squad alights into ruined plaza as feral zombies swarm -> Step 2 (6–12s): Vance fires underbarrel grenade launcher unleashing explosive fireball, Maya executes dual-pistol spin dodge -> Step 3 (12–18s): SLOW-MOTION BEAT: Gunner unleashes rotary minigun wall of lead in 60fps frozen shell casings -> Step 4 (18–24s): Recon sniper green laser headshots leaping zombies, squad tactical retreat -> Step 5 (24–30s): C4 detonation wipes out horde, Unit Zero holds heroic battle stance under searchlights as title hold resolves. Enforce explosive kinetic pacing, high-velocity choreography, advanced fire, fluid, and shrapnel simulation, and zero lag. Use separate production sheets for Commander Vance, Maya, Gunner & Recon, Feral Infected, Weapons & Tactical Props, and Metropolis Survival Zone. Keep Vance's eyebrow scar and olive gear, Maya's braided hair and dual pistols, Gunner's minigun, Recon's green IR laser, zombie pale veined skin, and ruined sunset city setting consistent throughout. VISUAL STYLE: Photorealistic live-action 35mm blockbuster trailer cinema quality, high-contrast apocalyptic lighting (deep orange sunset vs burning fire vs green IR lasers vs bright muzzle flashes), volumetric smoke, flying brass shell casings, and blood-fluid simulation, zero 3D or anime look. ENVIRONMENT: Ruined megacity plaza at dusk, abandoned burning vehicles, overturned buses, shattered glass skyscrapers, storm clouds, burning oil drums, debris-strewn concrete. AUDIO DIRECTIVE: Background Music: High-octane cinematic trailer score with thunderous orchestral drums, rising brass horns, aggressive industrial synth pulses, dipping into deep sub-bass during slow-motion, exploding into a triumphant crescendo. Sound Effects: Heavy engine roar, barricade crash BANG, heavy automatic rifle fire, rotary minigun spin-up roar, grenade explosion blast, bone-snapping strikes, bullet shell clatters. Vocal Audio: Tactical radio commands from Vance, lethal exhales from Maya, terrifying screeching roars from the feral zombie horde. TIMELINE: 0–6s (THE AMBUSH & ENTRY): Begin exterior. High-speed tracking shot. An armored 4x4 rescue truck smashes through an abandoned barricade in a ruined city plaza at dusk under a deep orange sunset sky. Commander Vance, Maya, and the squad leap out into immediate tactical formation as hundreds of fast feral zombies charge from alleyways and fire escapes. 6–12s (CQC & GRENADE FIREBALL BEAT): Unit Zero forms a tight defensive ring. Vance aims his assault rifle and fires an underbarrel grenade into a dense cluster of zombies, unleashing a massive, blinding orange fireball and flying debris. Simultaneously, Maya duck-slips a leaping zombie, firing her dual pistols point-blank before slashing a second infected throat with her trench knife. 12–18s (ULTRA SLOW-MOTION ROTARY MINIGUN BEAT): Playback drops to 60fps slow-motion. Sound dips to deep sub-bass pulse. Gunner steps forward, firing his heavy rotary minigun in a continuous arc. Golden bullet shell casings rain down in frozen mid-air motion, lit by blinding muzzle flares as the wall of lead tears through the front line of the charging horde. 18–24s (SNIPER RECON & TACTICAL RETREAT): Speed ramps back to 100% real-time. High-angle camera. Recon stands on the hood of an overturned bus, her green IR laser sight tracking target to target as she snaps off silenced headshots on zombies leaping from fire escapes. Vance calls out a tactical retreat as the squad moves backward toward an extraction LZ, firing controlled bursts. 24–30s (EXPLOSIVE CLIMAX & HERO FINISH): Vance triggers a wireless detonator, exploding a line of claymore charges behind them. A massive wall of fire engulfs the remaining zombie swarm. Unit Zero holds a low, victorious, battle-ready hero stance amidst rising smoke, backlit by fire and helicopter searchlights cutting from above. Camera holds tight on Vance and Maya's intense, battle-smudged faces. End on epic final frame. No text, no logos. CAMERA: Dynamic low-angle vehicle tracking, rapid whip-pans during CQC, speed-ramp zoom during 60fps slow-mo minigun fire, high-angle sniper pan, resolving to a stable heroic low-angle hero hold. MOVEMENT LOGIC: Weight: heavy, grounded, militaristic weight for Unit Zero operators; hyper-violent, reckless, erratic velocity for feral zombies. Time: relentless trailer pace transitioning into 60fps slow-motion minigun sweep, resolving into explosive 100% real-time climax. Space: wide ruined city plaza contracting into tactical defensive ring expanding through explosion fire. Flow: organized, synchronized, and tactical for operators; chaotic, swarming, and feral for the horde.

items.text: GPT image 2 Video Prompt: Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 stop-motion style premium coffee commercial for NESCAFÉ Original 3-in-1. Warm, cozy, energetic atmosphere with rich red, golden, cream, and dark-brown color tones. Use realistic miniature stop-motion animation, cinematic macro close-ups, shallow depth of field, warm golden lighting, detailed coffee beans, smooth handcrafted movements, and premium advertising quality. Scene 1 — 0:00–0:01 | Product Intro A NESCAFÉ 3-in-1 sachet slides smoothly into the center of the frame among roasted coffee beans. Warm golden bokeh in the background. Slight cinematic push-in. Add a soft pop/whoosh sound. Scene 2 — 0:01–0:02 | Open Sachet Two hands enter the frame and carefully tear open the NESCAFÉ sachet. Close-up POV, realistic hand movement and packaging details. Add a subtle tear sound. Scene 3 — 0:02–0:03 | Pour Coffee Mix The coffee mix pours from the opened sachet into a red NESCAFÉ cup. Capture the falling powder in beautiful macro detail. Smooth close-up camera movement with a satisfying pouring sound. Scene 4 — 0:03–0:04 | Add Hot Water Hot steaming water is poured into the cup. The coffee mixture begins dissolving and swirling naturally. Visible steam rises. Add realistic water-pouring sound. Scene 5 — 0:04–0:05 | Stir & Mix A spoon stirs the coffee in a smooth circular motion. The coffee transforms into a rich, creamy blend with realistic swirling patterns. Close macro shot with gentle stirring sound. Scene 6 — 0:05–0:06 | Steam & Aroma Extreme close-up of the finished hot coffee. Beautiful steam and subtle aroma-like wisps rise from the surface. Camera slowly pushes closer. Add a soft aroma whoosh. Scene 7 — 0:06–0:07 | Ready to Enjoy A hand gently lifts the red NESCAFÉ cup. Coffee beans remain visible on the table, warm golden background glowing behind it. Add a soft cup-lift sound. Scene 8 — 0:07–0:08 | Enjoy the Taste Close-up POV of the person taking a small sip of the coffee. Keep the shot elegant and natural, focusing on the warm coffee experience. Add a subtle satisfied “mmm” sound. Scene 9 — 0:08–0:09 | Product Hero Shot The NESCAFÉ 3-in-1 sachet and red coffee cup appear together in a perfect hero composition on a bed of coffee beans. Front-facing cinematic product shot, dramatic warm lighting, sharp product details, soft golden bokeh. Add a delicate jingle. Scene 10 — 0:09–0:10 | Final End Card Transition smoothly to a rich red background. Show the NESCAFÉ 3-in-1 pack and coffee cup with the tagline: “Secangkir Semangat, Sejuta Cerita.” Hold the frame cleanly for the final moment with a bright whoosh. Overall Style: ultra-realistic stop-motion commercial, premium coffee advertisement, cinematic macro photography, realistic steam, detailed coffee texture, warm golden lighting, smooth transitions, shallow depth of field, 4K quality, vertical 9:16, energetic yet cozy mood.

items.text: GPT Image 2 Prompt: UNIVERSAL LOGO IDENTITY MASTER PROMPT Use the uploaded logo EXACTLY as provided. Do NOT redesign, redraw, recolor, crop, distort, recreate, or modify it in any way. ASPECT RATIO: 5:7 Vertical LOGO PRESENTATION Remove any supporting surface completely. There must be: • No podium • No pedestal • No platform • No stage • No table • No floor stand • No display block • No base of any kind The logo must float naturally in mid-air as the single hero object with elegant cinematic depth. BACKGROUND Create a premium Apple-style luxury environment using the brand colors extracted from the uploaded logo. Include: • Soft brand-color to light grey gradient • Warm ivory highlights • Soft charcoal transitions • Golden hour lighting • Volumetric light rays • Atmospheric haze • HDR reflections • Cinematic glow • Soft bloom • Refined vignette • Elegant depth • Apple keynote minimalism The environment should feel clean, premium, bright, and sophisticated without becoming too dark. LOGO HERO Place the uploaded logo perfectly centered. The logo should float naturally with: • Soft rim lighting • Elegant glow • Glass reflections • Premium shadows • Cinematic depth • Balanced composition • No supporting surface underneath The uploaded logo remains completely untouched and is the unmistakable focal point. FLOATING BRAND ELEMENTS Automatically identify the brand's industry from the uploaded logo and generate premium floating elements that naturally represent that category. Examples include products, tools, materials, interface elements, symbols, packaging, abstract forms, or signature objects relevant to the brand. Arrange them naturally around the logo with generous spacing. Keep the composition elegant, balanced, and uncluttered. MATERIALS • Crystal Glass • Frosted Glass • Brushed Aluminium • Matte Metal • Chrome • Premium Acrylic • Ceramic • Transparent Glass • Luxury Polished Surfaces LIGHTING • Hollywood Commercial Lighting • Warm Key Light • Golden Hour Ambient Light • Luxury Rim Lighting • Soft Bounce Lighting • HDR Reflections • Ray Tracing • Global Illumination • Natural Highlights • Photorealistic Shadows COLOR PALETTE Extract the complete color palette directly from the uploaded logo. Extend it naturally into: • Premium gradients • Ambient glow • Reflections • Floating particles • Soft highlights Maintain perfect brand consistency throughout the composition. COMPOSITION • Swiss Grid • Golden Ratio • Apple-level Negative Space • Editorial Layout • Balanced Visual Hierarchy • Luxury Presentation • Minimal Yet Visually Rich TYPOGRAPHY PANEL Create a refined Swiss editorial information panel featuring: • Brand Name • Industry • Brand Personality • Brand Values • Primary Colors (HEX) • Typography Style • Target Audience • Brand Positioning • Brand Keywords • Visual Language Use clean white typography with premium spacing and alignment. CAMERA • 50mm Hero Lens • Eye-Level Perspective • Luxury Product Photography • Shallow Depth of Field • Ultra-Sharp Focus QUALITY • Apple Keynote • Pentagram • Landor • Luxury FMCG • Hollywood Commercial • IMAX • Octane Render • Unreal Engine 5 • Redshift • V-Ray • HDR • Ray Tracing • Global Illumination • 8K Ultra HD • Hyper-Realistic • Behance Featured • Red Dot Award • Awwwards • Cannes Lions FINAL OUTPUT Create a museum-quality luxury brand identity poster where: • The uploaded logo remains completely untouched. • The logo floats naturally in mid-air. • No podium, pedestal, platform, stage, table, display block, or base appears anywhere. • Premium floating elements intelligently reflect the brand's industry. • The background is clean, cinematic, luxurious, and Apple-inspired. • The composition is minimal, elegant, balanced, and award-winning.

items.text: 3. REALISTIC HUMAN VIDEO PROMPT Prompt: Generate an ultra-realistic cinematic scene featuring [CHARACTER] in [LOCATION] performing [ACTION]. Prioritize authentic human anatomy, natural facial expressions, realistic eye movement, believable body weight, accurate hand movement, natural cloth physics, realistic skin texture, environmental interaction, and physically correct lighting. Give the character a clear emotional progression from [EMOTION 1] to [EMOTION 2]. Use subtle imperfections that make the footage feel genuinely filmed rather than digitally generated. Keep the character's identity completely consistent throughout the entire shot. No distorted hands, plastic skin, unnatural expressions, random background changes, or artificial-looking movement.

items.text: 4. VIRAL SHORT-FORM VIDEO PROMPT Prompt: Create a highly scroll-stopping vertical video about [TOPIC] designed for short-form social media. The first second must create immediate curiosity without using cheap clickbait. Build a visual sequence where every shot introduces a new piece of information, visual surprise, or emotional escalation. Use fast but controlled pacing, strong composition, cinematic transitions, realistic motion, intentional camera movement, and a satisfying final payoff. The visual storytelling must work even without sound. Make every frame feel purposeful and premium, with no filler shots, generic stock-video aesthetics, or unnecessary visual effects.
